text:
alexa: tiny idea 12am footy watch in the lounge? cheap pool for who scores first + parking spot bet for Friday? :soccer:
ron: i'm down. whats the buy-in? i'm poor but enthusiastic.
nina: $2 to enter the pool, $1 to win the coveted Friday parking spot (lot B). winner takes both pots. chips optional.
pete: seriously the parking spot is the real prize. i'm in for both. also will cheer loudly.
sam: bringing a megaphone toy for extra motivation. yes i know it's terrible acoustics.
alexa: rules: first goal scorer prediction (name the player) wins the $2 pool. if no goals, pool rolls to next match. parking spot goes to whoever guesses correct match minute (closest wins).
ron: can we have a tie-breaker? penalties: rock-paper-scissors in the hallway.
cheerbot: Poll created by alexa: "Whos in?" Options: 1) Pool + parking 2) Pool only 3) Watch only. React with :one:, :two:, :three:.
nina: :one: locked
pete: :one: also bringing nachos.
ron: :two: i'll just do the pool. micro-commitment.
sam: :three: watching only (megaphone will still appear).
cheerbot: Poll closed. Results: 1) Pool + parking - 3 votes, 2) Pool only - 1 vote, 3) Watch only - 1 vote. Outcome: Pool + parking wins.
alexa: collecting $3 from each who picked both. Venmo @alexa-squad or cash preferred. please pay before kickoff (11:58pm).
nina: paid Venmo @nina-snacks (note: footy pot).
pete: cash in envelope on my desk. nachos also labeled.
ron: placed: first goal - "Fernandes". minute guess: 23.
sam: minute guess 42 (megaphone energy), no player pick since i'm watch only.
alexa: added picks to sheet: https://tiny.redwood/footy-nite (name / first-goal / minute / paid). please double-check.
cheerbot: Reminder posted: Kickoff 11:59pm in Lounge A. Streaming via HDMI.
ron: minor PSA: whoever wins parking spot needs to return it to on-call devs if they have an emergency deploy on Friday. no hoarding.
pete: fair. i'll sign a ceremonial surrender form.
nina: also side-bet: loser has to perform a 30-second goal celebration dance on Monday standup. stakes are high.
ron: already regretting my Fernandes pick. that dance will be wild. :grimacing: 
alexa: last note: no yelling at the backend engineers during halftime. they are sacred. clap only.
sam: acknowledged. structured cheering only.
cheerbot: Final reminder scheduled 11:45pm. Good luck and may the best striker win! :trophy:
